stories.title: Follow live: Emmett Johnson bursts through for TD as Chiefs take lead
Steelers owner: Rodgers' 'insubordination can't be tolerated,' backs McCarthy
stories.summary: Steelers owner Art Rooney II reacted to Wednesday's fiery interview from Aaron Rodgers by saying he was "disappointed in where this went" with their now-former quarterback, adding he has "100% confidence in Mike McCarthy."

stories.title: Brady disappointed in Rodgers' McCarthy comments: 'Nobody wins'
stories.summary: Tom Brady expressed his disappointment in how Aaron Rodgers handled his exit from Pittsburgh, saying there are things in the locker room that shouldn't be made public.

stories.title: Lions to 'move forward' after latest Thanksgiving heartbreak
stories.summary: Lions head coach Dan Campbell rued another heartbreaker on Thanksgiving but encouraged his team to still try and enjoy the night with their families.

stories.title: Dent-Smith leads 3-point spree as Saint Mary's stuns No. 6 UCLA
stories.summary: Jeremy Dent-Smith scored 21 points, and Saint Mary's stunned No. 6 UCLA with 15 3-pointers to hand the Bruins their first loss 85-70 on Thursday in the Rady Children's Invitational.
